styles.name: starter-footer-visual.css
styles.content: .wfv-footer{max-width:var(--wf-container-max-width,1160px);margin:auto;padding:32px 24px;border-top:1px solid var(--wf-color-border,#dce3e1);color:var(--wf-color-text,#172c25);font:14px/1.6 var(--wf-font-body,system-ui);display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:space-between;gap:24px}.wfv-footer img{display:block;max-width:160px;height:40px;width:auto;object-fit:contain;margin-bottom:12px}.wfv-footer img[src=""]{display:none}.wfv-footer p{margin:8px 0}.wfv-footer-contact{white-space:pre-line}.wfv-footer nav{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:16px}.wfv-footer a{color:inherit}.wfv-footer a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid currentColor;outline-offset:4px}.wfv-footer[data-variant="columns"]{display:grid;grid-template-columns:2fr 1fr 1fr}.wfv-footer[data-variant="columns"] nav{flex-direction:column}@media(max-width:700px){.wfv-footer,.wfv-footer[data-variant="columns"]{display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding:24px 16px}} .wfv-footer{background:var(--wf-color-surface)}.wfv-footer>*{min-width:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.wfv-footer[data-variant="contact"]{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,2fr)}.wfv-footer[data-variant="contact"] .wfv-footer-contact{font-size:1.1em}.wfv-footer[data-variant="contact"] nav{grid-column:1/-1}.wfv-footer-extras{width:100%;grid-column:1/-1}.wfv-footer-extras>.wf-slot{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:24px}.wfv-footer-extras:not(:has(.wf-instance)){display:none}@media(max-width:700px){.wfv-footer[data-variant="contact"]{display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding:24px 16px}.wfv-footer-extras>.wf-slot{flex-direction:column}}
